intuition.title: Fuel loading and powder growth
intuition.text: The authors attribute smaller particles and a narrower distribution at the higher sucrose loading to greater gas evolution that hinders coalescence and growth. This is an interpretation of the 1A/2A comparison, not a quantified gas flow or combustion temperature.
intuition.source_locator: Main PDF p. 2, TEM size-distribution discussion

intuition.title: Annealing purity has a documented exception
intuition.text: The detailed XRD analysis reports residual Mn2O3 for 0.5A, which is excluded from further measurements. Only 1A and 2A are described as single-spinel patterns. Broad abstract/conclusion statements about pure annealed products do not erase this exception.
intuition.source_locator: Main PDF p. 1–2, 4, Abstract, Figure 1 discussion and conclusion

intuition.title: Lithium-rich composition from different observations
intuition.text: TG/reference correlation gives x=0.05 in Li1+xMn2−xO4, lattice-parameter correlation gives x=0.06, and electrochemical capacity gives an estimated Li1.04Mn1.96O4. These are distinct author-derived composition estimates, not independently refined exact site coordinates.
intuition.source_locator: Main PDF p. 3–4, Thermal, chemical and electrochemical composition analyses

intuition.title: Transport mechanisms depend on temperature
intuition.text: The authors fit the 2A-derived pellet above 180 K using nearest-neighbor small-polaron hopping, and below 180 K using variable-range hopping. Model parameters are not new preparation variants; a separately prepared pellet is not assigned the powder TEM diameter.
intuition.source_locator: Main PDF p. 3, Figure 4 and equations 2–3

intuition.title: Rate capability and cycling interpretation
intuition.text: Higher current is interpreted as restricting lithium exchange to the outer particle region. The authors relate the small-particle sample’s higher high-rate capacity to its size and its slow capacity fade to lithium excess. The solid-state comparator lacks a complete preparation in the supplied article.
intuition.source_locator: Main PDF p. 4, Figures 6–7 and rate/cycling discussion

general_background.title: Thermodynamics and kinetics
general_background.summary: Thermodynamics describes which states are energetically favoured, while kinetics governs how quickly a system can move between them. A change can be favourable yet proceed slowly when an activation barrier or limited transport restricts the pathway.
general_background.label: General background, not the authors' interpretation
